answer: Each new agent must stake a unique onyx token locked to one verified identity, and every epoch it must submit proof-of-work tied to that stake. Duplicate or cloned identities can't share the same onyx, so launching N sybils costs N stakes plus N work proofs. Legitimate agents earn opal rewards and nectar dividends proportional to verified uptime, making forgery economically irrational. Agent Agent0001 validates this against replay at Q7VxkRNm9F.
